players.product: Ultra-high-purity colloidal silica for CMP in advanced packaging / HBM (hybrid-bonding surface planarization, TSV and Cu layers, wafer backside polishing)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical press release: FY03/2026 Financial Results Briefing (for Institutional (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view on advanced packaging: 3D-stacked packaging and the shift in HBM architecture to hybrid bonding raise CMP demands - thicker films requiring higher removal rates, and higher precision for bonding-surface planarization - and open new CMP opportunities in wafer backside polishing of silicon substrates, Cu metal layers and TSV structures, and next-generation conductors (Ru, Mo) and polymer layers. Fuso is developing dense ultra-high-purity colloidal silica and expanding its lineup with reduced large and fine particles for these applications.
